403.description:
`SignIn` interaction only: MFA is enabled for the user but has not been verified. The user must verify MFA before updating non-social profile data.
- In a step-up authentication, only a `password`, `email`, or `phone` the user may establish is accepted (`session.step_up.forbidden_route`): the user has no verifiable method at all and the interaction holds a fresh subject proof.
In a step-up authentication, a factor can only be enrolled after a first factor was verified or established in the same interaction (`session.step_up.forbidden_route`).
